about: B2 Search For The Missing Smith targets Ceard in the Cliffs of Moher

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'Cead;181', 'Ceard;200') WHERE ID = 21426
entries.why: steps 2 and 4 targeted Cead, an unrelated level 50 NPC in Caillte Garran (Shrouded Isles); the text and the period name Ceard, "the confused smith wandering the beach past the fogs in the Cliffs of Moher" (Allakhazam Search For The Missing Smith); Ceard himself and his wandering route are created by the patrols fixer (ownership: "Ceard's route")
the cursed ring Ceard hands back for Cleary was re-issued by Cead; Ceard is the step NPC
